_comment: Fresh install seeds this file as config.json (gitignored — never commit). Fill via ws-configure-project. toolsFile points to the tool vocabulary all agents use.

pathTokens._comment: Fixed install layout (not relocatable). Expand brace tokens before Read/Grep/Shell. Full contract: tools.md § Path tokens. plansDir/reviewsDir still resolve from plans.dir / reviews.dir.

stack.description: MCP stdio + CLI; Markdown records; SQLite FTS as disposable index

layers.name: mcp-cli
layers.role: Tool handlers, argument schemas, bootstrap budget

domain.model: Curated agent working memory outside product git (traps, decisions, specs, plans, logs)

providers._comment: active = work-item/spec source (github | azure-devops | local). scm = PR/thread host (github | azure-devops only; never local). Hybrid example: active=local + scm=github (local specs, GitHub PRs). If scm omitted: when active is github|azure-devops → scm=active; when active=local → infer from project.repoUrl host (github.com → github; dev.azure.com|visualstudio.com → azure-devops) or STOP and set scm explicitly. LEGACY: omit this entire providers block to infer active from issueTrackers.*.enabled (GitHub if enabled, else Azure DevOps, else local).

azureDevOps._comment: Set enabled: true and fill org/project. Put token in ADO_PAT (or AZURE_DEVOPS_PAT) — never commit it.

verification._comment_mutationTest: Optional mutation runner (e.g. npx stryker run, mvn org.pitest:pitest-maven:mutationCoverage). Empty = skip mutation substep in ws-testing Step 7.
verification._comment_mutationThreshold: Minimum mutation score percent (killed/(killed+survived)*100). Used when mutationTest is set and skipMutationTesting is false.
verification._comment_testGlobs: Machine test-surface probe patterns. Step 7 auto-skip requires no non-empty test alias and no matching file.

dagThresholds._comment: If ALL criteria are within limits, execMode is sequential (skip DAG).

defaults._comment_skipMutationTesting: When true (default), skip Step 7 mutation substep even if verification.mutationTest is set. Opt in by setting false and providing mutationTest.
defaults._comment_scoreAndRefine: Optional extra polish when Step 5 score is already >= 9. Score < 9 always runs scoreAndRefine until >= 9 (max 3 rounds, then Pause).
defaults._comment_autoload: When true, consumer intends repo-root AGENTS.md to autoload Always-applied skills from {sharedDir}/autoload.md. Omitted/missing/false → effective false; harness fails closed only when true.
defaults._comment_enableAuditing: When true, ws-spec-to-pr* orch runs under ws-audit runtime observer; writes {us-dir}/audit-*.log.md; logs anomalies/performance/correctness/disposable scripts; end-of-run may propose upstream GitHub issues or reusable tooling. Default false.
defaults._comment_enableDag: When true, break execution plan into multiple parallel tasks. When false (default), execute tasks sequentially one by one in serial order.
defaults._comment_contextBudget: Maximum UTF-8 bytes in one complete standard subagent dispatch; fixed contract preamble remains capped at 18000 and MEMORY at 4000.
defaults._comment_parallelVerifyReview: When true, standard Steps 5 and 6 may run concurrently as read-only reviewers after an immutable product commit; default false.
defaults._comment_gateGranularity: step prompts at every boundary; phase uses at most five blocking gates in a normal standard run without weakening hard stops.
defaults._comment_patterns: When true, ws-patterns-backend and ws-patterns-frontend are active for consulting backend.md and frontend.md during development.
defaults._comment_deliveryCommitArtifacts: Step 8 delivery commit includes under {us-dir}. Defaults: refined plan on; delivery result off (behavior change vs legacy always plan+result); opt-ins false. Omitted object/keys at read time merge to these AC1 defaults — never silently revert to always staging plan+result.
defaults._comment_models: Optional portable model identifiers for subagents. Fallback to the active session model if empty or unavailable. testingModel is the test executor for standard Step 7; empty/omitted uses executionModel. reviewerModel covers standard Steps 5-6 only.

plans._comment_plansDir: Resolve skill token {plansDir} from plans.dir (there is no separate plansDir key).
plans._comment_specsDir: Human-facing local specs dir. Skill token {specsDir} ← plans.specsDir (default .agents/specs). Prefer existing repo-root specs/ when already present. ws-write-spec writes here only; workflow step-00 copies under {plansDir}/{slug}/ come from providers or ws-local-spec-provider register.

reviews._comment: Optional local review artifact root (fix-pr / ws-goal-fix-pr round reports).

preview._comment: Optional ws-preview dry-run overrides. preview.backend is not required for v1 (defaults to cursor-reviewer).

rules._comment: Guardrails paths. Resolve per ws-shared/AGENTS.md External dependencies (first match). seniorDeveloper = Code review proof checklist source (default packaged ws-senior-developer); set "" to disable or point at another guardrail; karpathyGuidelines = surgical-change skill; stackFile = stack companion; changelogFile = append-only history (default under ws-shared/); other keys optional consumer rule paths — leave empty when unused.

fable._comment: Opt-in integration for fable-* skills within ws-spec-to-pr / ws-spec-to-pr-lite workflows. Master toggle must be true to enable automatic calls.
